title: Local vs URL vs server state: Use Zustand for genuinely shared client UI state, the URL for linkable filters and a dedicated data cache for remote server records.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Use Zustand for genuinely shared client UI state, the URL for linkable filters and a dedicated data cache for remote server records.
Repair the zustand-local-url-server intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for local vs url vs server state.
I can repair the 09.04.01 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
